headline: Engineering Manager
summary: Strategic Engineering Manager with over 10 years of experience in the Nepalese technology sector. Proven track record of leading high-performance cross-functional teams in agile environments. Transitioned from hands-on software development into technical leadership, focusing on scalable architecture, process optimization, and talent development.

experiences.title: Engineering Manager
description: Direct leadership for three cross-functional squads comprising 20+ engineers and QA analysts.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment lead time by 40% across core healthcare analytics products.
Mentored junior and mid-level engineers, resulting in a 25% internal promotion rate within the department.
Collaborated with US-based stakeholders to align technical roadmaps with business objectives.

experiences.title: Technical Lead
description: Led development of scalable web applications for international clients using React and Node.js.
Managed architectural reviews and code quality standards across multiple client projects.
Introduced Agile/Scrum methodologies to the team, improving sprint velocity by 30%.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Developed core components for mobile banking and payment gateway systems used by millions in Nepal.
Resolved critical production issues in high-concurrency systems, ensuring 99.9% uptime.
Authored technical documentation for API integrations with major commercial banks.
